zh: 大家好，我是余秋雨，我们继续讲课。
en: Hello everyone, I am Yu Qiuyu, let’s continue the lecture.

zhSentences.text: 大家好，我是余秋雨，我们继续讲课。

enSentences.text: Hello everyone, I am Yu Qiuyu, let’s continue the lecture.

zh: 因为上次我讲到庄子哲学里边的第一观念叫“物物者非物”，五个字，我估计我们的学员大多数都比较陌生，听了我的课，希望大家能够记住。以物质的概念来看物质的话，我们就不是创造者，我们就不是获得大道的人。所以，庄子的意思是，我们不要以物观物，应该以道来观物，以人来观物。
en: Because last time I talked about the first concept in Zhuangzi's philosophy called "things are not things", five words, I guess most of our students are relatively unfamiliar with it. After listening to my class, I hope everyone can remember it. If we look at matter from the perspective of matter, we are not the creators, and we are not the ones who have achieved the Great Way. Therefore, what Zhuangzi means is that we should not observe things in terms of things, but should observe things in terms of Tao and people.

zhSentences.text: 因为上次我讲到庄子哲学里边的第一观念叫“物物者非物”，五个字，我估计我们的学员大多数都比较陌生，听了我的课，希望大家能够记住。
以物质的概念来看物质的话，我们就不是创造者，我们就不是获得大道的人。
所以，庄子的意思是，我们不要以物观物，应该以道来观物，以人来观物。

enSentences.text: Because last time I talked about the first concept in Zhuangzi's philosophy called "things are not things", five words, I guess most of our students are relatively unfamiliar with it.
After listening to my class, I hope everyone can remember it.

Therefore, what Zhuangzi means is that we should not observe things in terms of things, but should observe things in terms of Tao and people.

zh: 这个观念，如果以物来观物的话，这个物，我们是泛化的。我们上次提到，你有多少财产，我有多少财产？你的房子有多大？我的房子有多大？你用了什么牌子的好车，我用的这是什么牌子的车？这比来比去的话，就是以物观物。以物观物的话，这个物，一定把创造事物的造物者——人，埋到物里去了。庄子说，人之所以成为人，因为他有道，有大道，我们应该以道观物。以道观物，我们就等于想站在山顶上来看山脚下的各种各样的事物了，你看，这个人在为钱财奔忙，这个人已经造了多少房子，这个人买了多少车，但这个人家里有什么问题，他正在奋斗着，他自以为自己快要成为第三名，其实可能在这个小圈子里他最多也是第三十名等等，这是以道来观他们，我们很想劝他们不要这么做。
en: If we view things in terms of objects, this concept is generalized. We mentioned last time, how much property do you have and how much property do I have? How big is your house? How big is my house? What brand of car did you use? What brand of car did I use? Comparing things here and there means observing things by looking at things. If we look at things in terms of things, this thing must have buried the creator of things, man, within the thing. Zhuangzi said that the reason why people become human is because they have Tao and Dao. We should view things with Tao. Viewing things from the Taoist perspective means that we want to stand on the top of a mountain and look at all kinds of things at the foot of the mountain. You see, this person is running for money, how many houses this person has built, how many cars this person has bought, but this person has some problems at home, he is struggling, he thinks he is about to become the third, in fact, he may be the thirtieth at most in this small circle, etc. This is viewing them from the Taoist, and we would like to advise them not to do this.

zh: 如果由物观物的话，我们就陷进去了，陷在里边了，陷在里边的时候越想越不对。我有的时候告诉好多家长了，你们把自己的孩子说成是语文在班级里边第五名，数学在班级里边第七名，这个真的是错了，不要这么排来排去，这个就是以分来观分。这个表明了，你要跳到高处去，你最终喜欢你的儿子或者女儿是什么呢？
en: If we look at things from the perspective of things, we will be stuck in it. When we are stuck in it, the more we think about it, the more wrong it becomes. I sometimes tell many parents that you say your children are fifth in the class in Chinese and seventh in the class in mathematics. This is really wrong. Don't rank them back and forth like this. This is to judge points by points. This shows that you have to jump to high places. What do you ultimately like about your son or daughter?

zh: 我多次讲，我说我对我的学生，我对于年轻人的要求，往往是六个字，一个善良，一个快乐，一个健康。没了，没有第七个字了。这个就是以道来观物，你想来想去，你想到，最后站在你眼前的那个年轻人，应该是什么样的人，才让你喜欢，让大家喜欢，让大家接受。如果你陷在那个分数堆、工资堆、房子堆、车子堆里边的话，那就是庄子所反对的，以物观物，不是以道观物。我再说一遍，叫物物者非物，要创造事物的人，本身并不是物质，我们本身应该是人，应该是道。这是庄子的思维，也是庄子对我们的一种解放。
en: I have said many times that my requirements for my students and young people are often six words: kindness, happiness, and health. No more, there is no seventh word. This is to view things from the Tao. You think about it over and over again. You think about what kind of person the young man standing in front of you should be in order for you to like him, for everyone to like him, and for everyone to accept him. If you are stuck in the pile of scores, piles of wages, piles of houses, and piles of cars, that is what Zhuangzi opposes, observing things with things, not with Tao. Let me say it again, what is called a thing is not a thing. People who want to create things are not matter themselves. We ourselves should be human beings and Tao. This is Zhuangzi’s thinking, and it is also a kind of liberation that Zhuangzi offers us.

zh: 庄子老想着这个解放了，你在物的一个圈子里边，一个人是钻不出来的，当然这个物的范围很大了，我前面已经讲到了，不仅是物质利益了，还讲到名，就名的排位，还讲到权，都属于庄子所说的物的范畴。我们跳开去，从更高的角度上，来看到一个世界的创造者，物质的创造者，应该是什么样的人？好，这是庄子的第一句话。
en: Zhuangzi always thinks about this liberation. You can't get out of a circle of things. Of course, the scope of this thing is very large. As I have mentioned before, it is not only material benefits, but also fame, ranking of fame, and power. They all belong to the category of things mentioned by Zhuangzi. Let us jump away and see from a higher perspective what kind of person should the creator of the world and the creator of matter be? Well, this is Zhuangzi's first sentence.

zh: 无待、无己
en: No waiting, no self

zh: 庄子的第二句话是三个字，叫“逍遥游”，这是他的一个有名的篇目的题目。我曾经多少次的抄写过《逍遥游》，为什么抄写？因为它既是我的艺术理想，也是我的人生理想。记得我在中央电视台的一次讲评当中，我曾经讲过“逍遥游”这三个字，是中国艺术和中国人生的最高的理想。
en: Zhuangzi's second sentence contains three words, called "Xiaoyaoyou", which is the title of one of his famous chapters. How many times have I copied "Xiaoyaoyou"? Why did I copy it? Because it is both my artistic ideal and my life ideal. I remember that in a commentary on CCTV, I once said that the three words "Happy Wandering" are the highest ideal of Chinese art and Chinese life.

I remember that in a commentary on CCTV, I once said that the three words "Happy Wandering" are the highest ideal of Chinese art and Chinese life.

zh: 逍遥游，这个说法，猛一看非常通俗，我们要逍遥自在，我们要游荡在万里长空当中，游荡在茫茫世界当中，这样的话是多么愉快。但实际上，按照庄子的说法，要真正做到逍遥游，有两个无，一个叫无待，我们不等待什么；第二，无己，我们自己没有太多的追求。
en: The term "free and easy travel" seems very popular at first glance. We want to be free and easy. We want to wander in the sky thousands of miles away and in the vast world. How happy it is to be like this. But in fact, according to Zhuangzi, to truly achieve a free and easy journey, there are two nothings. One is called no waiting, we don’t wait for anything; the second is selfless, we don’t have much pursuit of ourselves.

zhSentences.text: 逍遥游，这个说法，猛一看非常通俗，我们要逍遥自在，我们要游荡在万里长空当中，游荡在茫茫世界当中，这样的话是多么愉快。

zh: 什么叫无待？为什么不等待？就是任何等待，其实已经处于一种被动状态，已经处于一种被控制状态。譬如，庄子曾经讲过，有一种大鹏，在九天上飞翔的时候，凭着大风，能够飞行半个月，这给人家感到气魄非常大。但庄子提出疑问了，你要靠它大风才能飞半个月，壮观是虽然壮观，但是，你已经受到等待的束缚了，没有风你就飞不了，风转向你也得转向，风减速你也得减速，风停息你也得停息。当然，除了风之外，飞翔还要依赖别的很多条件，比如地域、时节等等。所以，人们所期待的自由飞翔是什么呢？
en: What is no wait? Why not wait? Any waiting is actually already in a passive state, already in a controlled state. For example, Zhuangzi once said that there is a kind of big roc that can fly for half a month with strong winds in the nine heavens. This makes people feel very powerful. But Zhuangzi raised a question, you have to rely on strong winds to fly for half a month. Although spectacular, you are already bound by waiting. You can't fly without wind. If the wind turns, you have to turn, if the wind slows down, you have to slow down, and if the wind stops, you have to stop. Of course, in addition to wind, flying also depends on many other conditions, such as region, season, etc. So, what is the freedom of flight that people expect?

zh: 我所说的待，其实就是一个控，控制的控。只要有过多的期待，你就有过多的被控制；结果你也就没有真正的自由飞翔。在庄子看起来，逍遥游是从内心摆脱一些期待，摆脱太多的期待和等待。这个和佛教的思维是一样的。我前面讲过，佛教认为因为这个东西是空的，你不能过多的期待，如果期待的话，那么你就变成了一个充满了痛苦的追求者，这样的话，痛苦一直会跟随在你的背后。所以，我们如果不要期待的话，不要有太多的依赖的话，这个待里边，还包括——等待的待——包括依赖的意思，不要有太多的依赖，甚至于说不要有任何更多的依赖的话，你才能逍遥游。这是一个，就要无待。
en: What I mean by "waiting" is actually a control, a control of control. As long as there are too many expectations, you will be too controlled; as a result, you will not be able to truly fly freely. In Zhuangzi's view, Xiaoyaoyou means getting rid of some expectations from the heart, getting rid of too many expectations and waiting. This is the same as Buddhist thinking. As I said before, Buddhism believes that because this thing is empty, you cannot expect too much. If you do, you will become a pursuer full of pain. In this case, pain will always follow you behind. Therefore, if we don’t have expectations and don’t have too much dependence, this “waiting” also includes the meaning of “waiting” including dependence. If we don’t have too much dependence, or even if we don’t have any more dependence, then you can have a free time. This is a case of no waiting.

zh: 另外，无己，你不要太自我，你不要老想着自己，我怎么样、我怎么样、我怎么样，如果这样想的话，你也不能逍遥。逍遥，被一个“我”字困住了，被自己的“己”字困住了。你怎么可以自由呢？我，在天上飞，其它鸟飞得比我快，或者飞得比我低，或者等等，他们更接群，他们的个数比我多，等等，想来想去，你整个飞翔都是不自由的。你如果终于做了天上飞的第一名了，你就会担忧第二名会不会很快赶上我，又会担忧第五第六名会不会耍弄阴谋诡计，让我受伤等等等等等等。只要有天上、有期待，有太多的自我，你就不能好好的自由的飞翔。所以，只有逍遥的思维才是庄子所理想的人生的思维。
en: In addition, Wuji, don't be too self-centered, don't always think about yourself, how am I, how am I, how am I? If you think like this, you can't be free. Xiaoyao was trapped by the word "I" and his own character "Ji". How can you be free? I am flying in the sky, and other birds fly faster than me, or fly lower than me, or wait, they are more swarming, there are more of them than me, etc. After thinking about it, your whole flight is not free. If you finally become the first person in the sky, you will worry about whether the second place will soon catch up with me, and you will worry about whether the fifth and sixth places will play tricks and cause me to get hurt, etc., etc. As long as there is heaven, expectations, and too much self, you will not be able to fly freely. Therefore, only carefree thinking is the thinking of Zhuangzi’s ideal life.

zhSentences.text: 另外，无己，你不要太自我，你不要老想着自己，我怎么样、我怎么样、我怎么样，如果这样想的话，你也不能逍遥。
逍遥，被一个“我”字困住了，被自己的“己”字困住了。
你怎么可以自由呢？
我，在天上飞，其它鸟飞得比我快，或者飞得比我低，或者等等，他们更接群，他们的个数比我多，等等，想来想去，你整个飞翔都是不自由的。
你如果终于做了天上飞的第一名了，你就会担忧第二名会不会很快赶上我，又会担忧第五第六名会不会耍弄阴谋诡计，让我受伤等等等等等等。
只要有天上、有期待，有太多的自我，你就不能好好的自由的飞翔。
所以，只有逍遥的思维才是庄子所理想的人生的思维。

enSentences.text: In addition, Wuji, don't be too self-centered, don't always think about yourself, how am I, how am I, how am I?
If you think like this, you can't be free.
Xiaoyao was trapped by the word "I" and his own character "Ji".
How can you be free?
I am flying in the sky, and other birds fly faster than me, or fly lower than me, or wait, they are more swarming, there are more of them than me, etc.
After thinking about it, your whole flight is not free.

If you finally become the first person in the sky, you will worry about whether the second place will soon catch up with me, and you will worry about whether the fifth and sixth places will play tricks and cause me to get hurt, etc., etc.
As long as there is heaven, expectations, and too much self, you will not be able to fly freely.
Therefore, only carefree thinking is the thinking of Zhuangzi’s ideal life.

en: I once said that the goal of Confucianism is the gentleman, the goal of Buddhism is the enlightened person, and the goal of Taoism is the true person. zh: 他的原文很滔滔不绝，也不太复杂，他在《大宗师》里边说：“何为真人？古之真人，不逆寡，不雄成，不谟士。若然者，过而弗悔，当而不自得也；若然者，登高不栗，入水不濡，入火不热。是知之能登假于道者也若此。”
en: His original text is very eloquent and not too complicated. He said in "The Great Master": "What is a true person? A true person in ancient times does not rebel against the few, is not powerful, and is not immoral. If so, he will not regret it after passing, and he will not be complacent; if so, he will not tremble when climbing high, not wet when entering water, and not hot when entering fire. This is also the case for those who know how to ascend the false path and follow the Tao."

zh: 什么是真人？古代的真人，不欺弱，不自雄，不计谋。这样的人，失了不懊悔，成了不自得；这样的人，登高不颤抖，落水不沉溺，入火不觉得热。只有见识合于道的人才能这样。
en: What is a real person? The real people in ancient times did not bully the weak, do not assert themselves, and did not plot. Such a person does not feel regretful when he loses something, and becomes unsatisfied; such a person does not tremble when he climbs a height, does not sink when he falls into the water, and does not feel the heat when he enters the fire. Only those whose knowledge is consistent with the Tao can do this.

zhSentences.text: 什么是真人？
古代的真人，不欺弱，不自雄，不计谋。
这样的人，失了不懊悔，成了不自得；这样的人，登高不颤抖，落水不沉溺，入火不觉得热。
只有见识合于道的人才能这样。

enSentences.text: What is a real person?

Only those whose knowledge is consistent with the Tao can do this.

zh: 古代的真人，睡觉无梦，醒来无扰，饮食不求香甜，呼吸又深又透。真人的呼吸能够贯通脚跟，而常人的呼吸却只在喉咙。一个人如果屈服于他人，言语就会受阻。那么，如果屈服欲望，天然的根器也就浅了。古代的真人，不贪恋生，不厌恶死。对于出生，并不欣喜；对于死亡，也不拒绝。自由自在地去，就像自由自在地来。不忘记起点，不追求终点。事情来了就欣然接受，如果忘了，就恢复自然。这就是说，不用人心去损害大道，不用人力，去加注天然，这才称得上真人。
en: The real people in ancient times slept without dreams, woke up without disturbance, did not seek sweet food and drink, and breathed deeply and thoroughly. The breath of a real person can penetrate through the heels, but the breath of ordinary people is only in the throat. Speech will be hindered if one gives in to others. Then, if you give in to your desires, your natural faculties will be shallow. The real people in ancient times were not greedy for life and did not hate death. There is no joy in being born; there is no rejection in death. Feel free to go as you feel free to come. Don’t forget the starting point and don’t pursue the end point. Accept it happily when it comes, and go back to nature if you forget it. This means that one can be called a true person only if he does not use the human heart to harm the Tao and does not use manpower to add to nature.

这就是说，不用人心去损害大道，不用人力，去加注天然，这才称得上真人。

en: The ancient true man did not know how to talk about life, nor did he know how to hate death; he did not like to go out, and did not leave when he came in; Don’t forget the beginning, don’t seek the end; accept it and enjoy it, forget it and return to it. This is what is called not donating the Tao with your heart, not using people to help Heaven, this is what is called a true person. )
